notes: 2026-02-25 - Eval review with infra sec and compliance. High level agreement on VPC private deployment, want full audit trail before procurement.
Key ask: push structured audit logs to their Splunk HEC and archival S3 bucket with customer-managed KMS keys (CMK).
SIEM export expectations: near-real-time (<=30s avg), support for HTTP/HEC and syslog (CEF) endpoints. Must support bulk export to S3 for long-term archive.

Desired log schema: JSON schema with fields: timestamp, request_id, tenant_id, model_name, model_version, route, latency_ms, token_count, prompt_hash (SHA256), response_status, error_code, node_id, region, source_ip (anonymized), auth_method, user_id (hashed). Security team: NO plaintext prompt/response in logs.
Retention policy: operational logs (30-90 days), security/audit archives (7 years) - retention must be configurable per log class and exportable to WORM S3 bucket with immutability support.
Access logs: admin/console actions, API key rotations, service-account usage. Need tamper-evident storage and audit trail for CISO audits.
KMS integration: customer CMK mandatory for archive bucket; require key rotation plan and ability to re-encrypt exports on rotation. HSM-backed key option requested.

Log delivery mechanics discussed: options = push from runtime -> Fluent Bit -> Splunk HEC or push to S3 then customer Glue/Snowflake. Prefer option with small buffering and retry logic, backpressure handling.
Privacy controls: field-level redaction hooks, hashing of any PII, deterministic hashing for user_id to enable attribution without revealing identity.
Performance concerns: logging at token granularity would blow up throughput/cost — propose request-level metadata only + optional sampling for deep-dive traces (5% sampling).
Security team quote: "We need a proof that audit logs cannot be used to reconstruct prompts; hashed prompt digest + no response text is must-have."
POC plan: 2-week POC with 2 routes (chat, search). Deliver sample log stream to their dev Splunk instance and S3 archive. Measure delivery latency and SLOs.
